messages:
nate: Proposal: pin runtime 6.0.2 -> 5.9.8 for EU and LATAM during the maintenance window (2025-11-12 01:00-03:00 UTC). Root cause: increased p99 latency for quantized models on 6.0.2 with our new arena allocator.

sara: Is this a full rollback or a soft-pin with canary first?

nate: Soft-pin. Start with 1% canary in EU, 0.5% LATAM, manual gate to 10%. We also want to exclude clients reporting header `x-client-sdk: 5.*` because thereare a known keepalive change that might confound results.

deploy-bot: plan created: soft-pin-runtime-6.0.2-to-5.9.8 | window: 2025-11-12T01:00Z-03:00Z | canary EU 1% -> 10% @20m | canary LATAM 0.5% -> 5% @25m | predicate: not header('x-client-sdk').matches('^5\\.')

ops-jordan: we need an explicit rollback runbook and CS note for managed customers in LATAM. Also sanity-check that 5.9.8 bundles are preloaded to avoid cold starts.

infra-mike: I pre-warmed 5.9.8 images in EU and LATAM staging and patched the autoscaler to prefer warm pools. Cold start delta measured ~180ms.

qa-arya: ran quick regression in staging: 5.* SDK + runtime 6.0.2 -> intermittent keepalive resets; confirmed reproduction under 200 persistent streams. Logs show: "connection reset during keepalive ping".

sara: Do we have header coverage? If many clients don't send x-client-sdk we might accidentally include them in canary and see failures.

deploy-bot: telemetry: x-client-sdk header present in ~64% EU requests and ~50% LATAM. Unknown UA cohort will be excluded from canary by predicate (safe default).

nate: Good. Exclude unknown UA too. Predicate updated: `not header('x-client-sdk').matches('^5\\.') and header('x-client-sdk').exists()`

ops-jordan: approve with conditions: attach rollback runbook, add post-deploy alert for p99 latency/keepalive resets, CS message draft required.

cs-lena: I'll draft customer messaging explaining that customers on SDK 5.x will be excluded from the initial canary and why; will send to managed accounts and post a short note to status page if customers ask.

nate: rollback runbook: 1) abort canary expansion, 2) set default runtime eu/latam to 5.9.8 via `deploybot set-default-runtime <region> 5.9.8`, 3) drain 6.0.2 canary nodes, 4) if p99 latency not stable within 15m escalate to oncall.

deploy-bot: PR for deploy rule opened: github.com/redwood/deploy-rules/pull/789 | predicate `header('x-client-sdk').exists() and not header('x-client-sdk').matches('^5\\.')` with unit tests.

qa-arya: adding an alert: keepalive resets >0.2% OR p99 latency increase >15% for canary cohorts.

infra-mike: will enable extra tracing for allocator metrics on canary nodes (arena fragmentation, allocation stalls). Data will post to the pin ticket.

sara: Suggest we also mark the release notes: "6.0.2: allocator optimizations; temporary pin back due to tail latency on some quant workloads; SDK 5.x clients excluded from canary." Keeps ops + customers informed.

nate: timeline: canary start 2025-11-12T01:10Z EU and LATAM. Manual gate at 01:30Z EU, 01:35Z LATAM. Please be ready for a 01:25 pre-check.

deploy-bot: canary started: EU 1% at 2025-11-12T01:10Z | LATAM 0.5% at 2025-11-12T01:12Z | excluded SDK 5.x and unknown UA.

qa-arya: first 15m: EU p99 down ~12% compared to pre-pin and keepalive resets within baseline for included cohorts. LATAM similar trend. No auth or error-rate regressions.

nate: hold for manual gates. If infra traces show allocator stalls, we'll pause expansion.

infra-mike: allocator traces show modest fragmentation uptick on 6.0.2; correlating with latency spikes in some model families. Capturing heap dumps for one affected canary node.

sara: pending manual thumbs. If QA and infra are green, expand EU -> 10% and LATAM -> 5% in staggered steps.

cs-lena: customer note queued; sending to managed accounts after the 02:00 UTC checkpoint if expansion proceeds.

ops-jordan: approving proceed to expand to 5% LATAM and 10% EU now. Remember to keep rollback commands handy.

deploy-bot: expansion executed: EU -> 10% at 2025-11-12T01:35Z; LATAM -> 5% at 2025-11-12T01:40Z. Monitoring active.

qa-arya: 10m after expansion: p99 stable; keepalive resets remain within baseline (<0.05%). No action required.

nate: thanks all. Post-deploy followups: - runtime team to harden allocator (infra-mike) - SDK team to evaluate keepalive compatibility notes for SDK 5.x (sara) - cs-lena to publish customer note if any managed customer reports issues.

sara: will open SDK ticket to add optional keepalive backward-compat flag for 5.x clients.
